bridges.source:
Title: The Kettle
Author: Sam Okafor

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

[[Too still? She should flinch.]]

The kettle **screams**. Mara doesn’t move.

MARA ^
(quietly)
Not yet.

# ACT ONE

= The kettle, again.

CUT TO:

[[A last thought.]]
